sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. Define the terms 'electronegativity' and 'ionisation energy'. (2 marks)
2. Write the structural formula of ethene and state one use of it. (3 marks)
3. Using the diagram, name the products collected at the anode and cathode during electrolysis of dilute sulphuric acid. (4 marks)
4. Explain the difference between an exothermic and an endothermic reaction. (2 marks)
5. Calculate the concentration in mol/dm^3 of a solution containing 4 g of NaOH in 250 cm^3 (Na = 23, O = 16, H = 1). (4 marks)
